about_the_game:
About

IdleDownloadManager is a lightweight utility tool that monitors your selected folder for downloads and automatically shuts down your PC once downloads are complete. Perfect for downloading large games or other large files. No more wasted power or unnecessary PC wear.

Features

  • Smart Download Monitoring
    Automatically tracks file activity in your chosen folder and detects when downloads are completed.

  • Idle Detection & Auto-Shutdown
    Shuts down, hibernates, or runs a custom command after download is detected as completed.

  • Customizable Shutdown Options
    Choose between shutdown, sleep, restart, or executing your own custom scripts.

  • Cross-Platform Support
    Available on Windows and Linux.

  • Minimal Resource Usage
    Runs quietly in the background with a clean, minimalist UI.

Ideal for gamers, power users, and anyone who downloads large files.
